title: FAQ
intro: Short answers to the questions people ask most about SubMark.

items.question: What is SubMark?
items.answer: A free, open-source app for tracking subscriptions, one-time purchases and free trials. It shows what is due next and what you spend per month and per year.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. There is no sign-up and no SubMark server. Everything you enter is stored on your device.

items.question: How do I add a subscription?
items.answer: Tap the add button on the Subscriptions tab. Enter a name, price and billing cycle; the next payment date is calculated for you. You can turn optional form sections on or off in Settings > Customization.

items.question: What is the difference between pausing and archiving?
items.answer: A paused subscription stops generating payments. With archive mode on (Settings > Customization), paused subscriptions also leave the main list and appear in the archive, where you can restore them.

items.question: Why did I not get a reminder?
items.answer: Check that notifications are allowed for SubMark and turned on in Settings > Notifications. Some phones delay alarms to save battery; allowing SubMark to run unrestricted in the system battery settings usually helps.

items.question: Can I set different reminders per subscription?
items.answer: Yes. Open a subscription and add custom reminders with their own days-before and time. Otherwise the defaults from Settings > Notifications apply.

items.question: What happens with auto-renewing subscriptions?
items.answer: When an auto-renewing payment date passes, SubMark records the payment and moves to the next date the next time the app runs.

items.question: Which currency are totals shown in?
items.answer: Your default currency, set in Settings > Region and currency. Other currencies are converted with the latest exchange rates SubMark has downloaded.

items.question: Where do exchange rates come from?
items.answer: From free public sources (Frankfurter, with community-maintained mirrors as fallback). You can also enter a fixed rate for any currency or add your own custom currency.

items.question: What are wallets for?
items.answer: Wallets let you track a balance, such as a prepaid card or a credit line. Payments linked to a wallet are deducted automatically, and reversing a payment refunds the wallet.

items.question: How do I move my data to a new phone?
items.answer: Export a backup file in Settings > Data management and import it on the new phone, or back up to your own WebDAV server and restore from there.

items.question: Are passwords and API keys included in backups?
items.answer: No. Secrets such as WebDAV passwords and API keys stay encrypted on the device and are never written to exports. Re-enter them after restoring.

items.question: Can I delete everything?
items.answer: Yes. Data management has an option to erase all data. This cannot be undone, so export a backup first if you might need it.

items.question: Does SubMark collect analytics?
items.answer: No. SubMark has no analytics, ads or tracking.

items.question: Can I protect the app with a passcode?
items.answer: Yes. Settings > Security lets you set a 4-digit passcode and, on supported devices, unlock with your fingerprint or face. The app locks on start and after 30 seconds in the background.

items.question: I forgot my passcode. What now?
items.answer: The passcode cannot be recovered. Clearing the app's storage in Android settings removes the lock together with all local data, so keep a recent backup.
